MoneyKeel · your logo, in every place it shows

MoneyKeel · the logo · v02 · 2026-10-30 · drawn from the build, with your logo in every place it shows
PointWhat it says
Approved beforeNo logo decision of yours is in the decision log. On 2026-07-14 you picked the K mark; that is recorded only in the code history, with no DEC number. Brand drawing v01 (2026-07-24) put the logo art on sign-in, first run and the top bar. No approval of v01 is on record; its own note of 2026-10-27 says so.
Your feedback beforeBuild 45, 2026-07-24: the name MoneyKeel showed in black on sign-in and in flat green elsewhere, and matched the designed logo nowhere. This is the record’s summary, not your words: docs/FCC-core-55-70/build45-feedback-root-causes-2026-07-24.md, item 3.
Your instruction today2026-10-30: “change the logo to attached”. Your three files are kept, unchanged, in MoneyKeel/documents/other/brand-source-2026-10-30/.
What is newYour logo replaces the K everywhere it shows: the top bar on every screen (a tab, and a screen with ‘‹ Back’), sign-in, first run, the launch screen, the iPhone icon, the Android icon, the web tab icon and the website pack. Only the logo changes: no word, button or colour of any screen moves.
The stray ‘a’Your files read ‘aMoneyKeel’; the app is MoneyKeel everywhere. The ‘a’ is cut off cleanly. In your full logo it is columns 333 to 381 and the M starts at 382; in your lettering-only file, 24 to 79, with the M at 81 to 82. To reverse: use your files as given.
Which file each piece comes fromYour lettering-only file cuts off the last ‘l’ of Keel through its stem and drops the ‘r’ of Center (106 dark pixels touch its right edge). So the lettering and the tagline come from your full logo, and the mark from your mark file, the largest you sent. To reverse: name the file to use.
SizesThe MoneyKeel lettering keeps the width it had: 84 points in the top bar, 150 on sign-in, 170 on first run; its height follows your art. The mark keeps its size beside the lettering in your full logo, 0.6 of its width: 89 × 44 on sign-in, 101 × 50 on first run, where the K was a square 84 and 92.
The launch screenYour full logo as you laid it out, the ‘a’ gone and the lettering moved left 36 pixels to line up with the tagline. Drawn at your file’s own size, centred on white.
The iconsiPhone: your mark centred on white, one-eighth of the icon clear on each side, with no see-through part (Apple refuses one). Android: the mark inside the middle circle that Android never trims, on white.
Softness, measuredYour mark file is 460 pixels wide and the iPhone icon is 1024, so the mark is stretched 1.77 times. Its edges blur over 2.4 pixels; a mark drawn at that size blurs over 0.85. On a home screen (180 pixels) it cannot be seen; on the App Store’s full-size icon it can. The fix: the mark as an SVG, or a PNG at least 1024 pixels wide.
The old logoKept, nothing deleted: assets/brand/archive-2026-10-30/ (the K pictures and both K drawings) and the website pack’s logo/archive-2026-10-30/. Brand drawing v01 is in this folder’s archive/.
Not decisions of yoursThe ‘a’, the files used, the sizes, the launch screen and the icons are the lead’s decisions of 2026-10-30, made without asking you, as your order of 2026-09-30 says. One word from you reverses any of them.

The Android icon, every shape a phone may cut it to. The dashed circle is the part Android never trims (66 of 108); every pixel of your mark sits inside it, the furthest 297 of a 313-pixel radius.
